title: 情報工学専門実験・演習B
subtitle: Information and Computer Science Major Lab/Exercises B
keywords: Lego Mindstorms 2.Developing embedded system 3.Android programming 4.UI and APIs 5.Solution proposal
educationalGoal: - Students will acquire knowledge and skills for developing control systems and embedded systems using object-oriented programming while making control programs for a Lego Mindstorms line tracing car. - Students will also acquire knowledge and skills for developing Android applications using various UI and APIs and propose valuable IT solutions.
advice: Overview of this class: [Developing control programs for Lego Mindstorms] 1) Introduction of Lego Mindstorms and installation of development environment. 2) Object-oriented programming for Java based on UML design. 3) Basic motions and control methods of Lego Mindstorms. 4) Development of individual control programs for line trace car, i.e., defining requirements, design (modeling by UML), implementation, testing, and refinement. 5) Demonstrate results of individual control program, i.e., time trial. [Developing Android apps] 6) Introduction of development environment and basic Android programming. 7) Android programming using various UIs. 8) Android programming using APIs and proposing an IT solution. 9) Android programming using “Intent” and implementation of the IT solution. 10) Presentation on the IT solution
books: Required Materials will be provided in the class.
requiredKnowledge: - Review Java programming and object-oriented development. - Review basic mechanisms of computer networks (TCP/IP). - Review the methods of group development.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the motions of a Lego Mindstorms line trace car.
Be able to develop individualized control programs using IDEs (such as Eclipse).
Be able to develop basic Android apps using a proper UI.
Be able to develop useful Android apps using proper APIs.
Be able to propose valuable IT solutions with Android apps.

achievementLevels.ideal: [Developing control programs for Lego Mindstorms] -Students with ideal achievement levels can design and implement practical control programs for Lego Mindstorms using object-oriented programming and explain complicated control methods for Lego Mindstorms car with sensors and servomotors. [Developing Android apps] -Students with ideal achievement levels can implement Android apps realizing high usability using various UIs and APIs and they can also understand the customer needs sufficiently and deploy IT solutions based on them, as well as present them to customers in a comprehensive way.
achievementLevels.standard: [Developing control programs for Lego Mindstorms ] -Students with standard achievement levels can implement basic control programs using object-oriented programing based on a given design and explain simple control methods for a Lego Mindstorms car with sensors and servomotors. -They can implement control programs with Java. [Developing Android apps] -Students with standard achievement levels can implement basic Android apps using online documents for developers and they can also understand what IT solutions are applicable and acquire the basic skills for proposing them.

lessons.content: [Developing control programs for Lego Mindstorms ] Introduction of Lego Mindstorms and installation of development environment [Developing Android apps] Learn the overview of the apps development and introduce development environment
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: [Developing control pro- grams for Lego Mind-storms] Review basic Java pro-gramming and how to use Eclipse. [Developing Android apps] Introduce development environment for Android apps in each student’s notebook computer and review Java programming.

lessons.content: Lego Mindstorms programming 1: Learn programming and tuning up basic programs for input and output (i.e., sensors and servomotors).
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Preview basic object ori-ented programming (classes, fields, methods, and object), and how to write in Java.

lessons.content: Lego Mindstorms programming 2: Learn programming basic control pro-grams based on given specifications in UML.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Preview abstract class, concrete class, and the Strategy pattern.

lessons.content: Lego Mindstorms programming 2: Extend basic control programs by introducing system control techniques to improve speed and stability. 1st report.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Preview on-off control and PID control.

lessons.content: Developing own control programs 1: Analyze line trace courses and design individualized control programs.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check

lessons.content: Developing own control programs 2: Implement and test individualized control programs
lessons.assignments: Review test results and consider further improve-ment.

lessons.content: Developing own control programs 3: Improve individualized control programs to make them faster and more stable Final report.
lessons.assignments: Record test data and make report.

lessons.content: Demonstrate own control programs, i.e., run line trace courses in a time trial.
lessons.assignments: Review all topics of this class and connect them for future studies and re-search.

lessons.content: Android programming 1: Learn basic Android programming using various UI.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Review Android programming with UI and prepare for event-driven programming.

lessons.content: Android programming 2: Learn Android programming using several “View” and event-driven processes.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Review the programming with View and event-driven processes and prepare for programming with APIs.

lessons.content: Android programming 3: Learn Android programming using various APIs (Multimedia, Graphics, Database).
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, Experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Review the programming with APIs and consider the overview of IT solutions.

lessons.content: Android programming 4: Learn Android programming using various APIs (Sensors, Google Maps). Present the idea of IT solutions.
lessons.assignments: Review the programming with APIs and develop the apps for IT solutions.

lessons.content: Android programming 5: Learn Android programming using “Intent” for cooperation between apps.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Review the programming with Intent and develop the apps for IT solutions.

lessons.content: Develop IT solutions with Android apps and prepare the final presentation and report.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, experiment, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Develop IT solutions with Android apps and prepare the final presentation and report.

lessons.content: Present developed IT solution with Android apps and submit the final report.
lessons.operation: Lecture, exercise, presentation, and self- check
lessons.assignments: Review all topics of this class and connect them for future studies and research.
